correctness.rationale: For x∈R^n the constant-annihilating centered prefix sum satisfies (T x)_j−(T x)_i=(1/n) sum_{r∈(i,j]} sum_{s∉(i,j]}(x_r−x_s). Counting intervals separating a pair (p,q) gives N_{p,q}=(q−p)(n−q+p), hence upper bound floor(n²/4)/n. The singleton e1 has ratio (n+1)/6, so strict amplification for every n≥6. Coarea/layer-cake over binary cuts is valid for any constant-annihilating linear map and Gini seminorm; exhaustive all 52 proper binary cuts for n=2..5 yields exact maxima 1/2,2/3,5/6,1. Independent exact rational checks reproduced each by subset size and independently verified crossing-count coefficient up through n=14. No claimed sharp n≥6 norm.
